formula_description: composite = (quality^wQ * durability^wD * performance^wP) * 10, where each axis is 0-10 scale, weights sum to 1.0

calibration_products.name: Porcelanosa Dover Caliza (Large Format Porcelain Floor)
calibration_products.notes: Grupo Porcelanosa — manufactured in Castellón, Spain (global tile capital). Advanced HD inkjet on dense color-body porcelain. Large-format rectified for precision installation. Water absorption <0.1%. DCOF ≥0.60 on textured variants. Breaking strength >2000N. Mohs 7+ surface. Full frost resistance. Class A chemical resistance. 39 luxury listing sightings. Porcelanosa operates branded showrooms globally — premium distribution model. Limited lifetime warranty.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Grupo Porcelanosa (private, family-owned since 1973, Castellón Spain)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Private family-owned since 1973. €1B+ annual revenue. Vertically integrated (raw materials through retail showrooms). No going-concern risk. Global premium tile leader.

calibration_products.name: Crossville Virtue (Through-Body Porcelain Floor)
calibration_products.notes: Crossville Inc — manufactured in Crossville, Tennessee USA. Through-body porcelain: color extends through entire tile — chips and edge damage are invisible. Unglazed surface achieves PEI 5 equivalent (full-depth wear resistance). PTCA certified porcelain. Water absorption <0.5%. DCOF ≥0.60 (natural matte surface). Made in America with identified single factory. Limited lifetime warranty. Leading US tile sustainability program (ISO 14001, Cradle to Cradle). Professional/commercial grade used in residential luxury.
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Private US manufacturer. Leading American technical porcelain producer. Strong architect specification base. No going-concern risk.

calibration_products.name: Daltile Panoramic Porcelain (Large Format)
calibration_products.notes: Daltile — Mohawk Industries subsidiary. Largest tile manufacturer/distributor in US. White body porcelain with advanced HD inkjet surface. Rectified for precision installation. Multiple US manufacturing plants + partner factories. PTCA certified on qualifying lines. Consistent quality, massive distribution network, architect-specified for reliability. Limited lifetime residential warranty. The 'reliable premium' — not artisan but consistently well-made.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Mohawk Industries (NYSE: MHK — owns Daltile, Marazzi USA, American Olean)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Mohawk Industries is the world's largest flooring company. $10B+ revenue. NYSE listed. No going-concern risk.

calibration_products.name: Marazzi Color Body Porcelain (Italian Production)
calibration_products.notes: Marazzi — founded 1935 in Sassuolo, Italy (heart of Italian ceramics district). Now Mohawk-owned but Italian production lines remain in Italy. Color body construction reduces chip visibility. Advanced Italian digital inkjet technology. Deep ceramic heritage (90+ years). Italian Marazzi vs Marazzi USA are different products — Italian lines maintain Sassuolo precision. Rectified. Limited lifetime warranty from Mohawk backing.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Mohawk Industries (NYSE: MHK — acquired Marazzi Group 2013)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Mohawk backing with Italian manufacturing heritage. Dual advantage: Italian precision + US distribution/warranty infrastructure.

calibration_products.name: MSI Aria Bianco Porcelain (24x24)
calibration_products.notes: MSI (M S International) — major global distributor based in Orange, CA. Distributor model (NOT manufacturer): sources from global partner factories. MSI selects competitive specs and price points. Aria Bianco is their marble-look porcelain — widely available through Floor & Decor, Home Depot, tile showrooms. Rectified 24x24. PEI 4. PTCA certification claimed on packaging. Installer reports of inconsistency in shade matching between lots. Decent specs on paper — positioning reflects distribution/source model rather than manufacturing excellence.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: MSI (M S International, Inc. — private, Orange CA, founded 1975)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Large, diversified private distributor. Countercyclical product mix (stone, tile, LVP, quartz). Growing market share.

calibration_products.name: American Olean Theoretical Bold Ceramic
calibration_products.notes: American Olean — Mohawk Industries subsidiary (same parent as Daltile, Marazzi). US manufacturing. Standard white-body ceramic with digital inkjet glaze. Calibrated (sorted by size) but not fully rectified on all lines. THE ceramic benchmark — 'good enough for a quality residential installation.' PEI 3 (light-moderate traffic). Water absorption in vitreous range (0.5-3%). Lifetime limited warranty from Mohawk backing. Positioned below Daltile premium lines within the same corporate family — different products from same parent.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Mohawk Industries (NYSE: MHK — owns Daltile, Marazzi USA, American Olean)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Mohawk backing. Oldest ceramic tile brand in US (founded 1923). Heritage plus corporate strength.

calibration_products.name: Merola Tile (Home Depot Imported Ceramic)
calibration_products.notes: Merola Tile — Home Depot-stocked imported ceramic. Multiple OEM sources (Spain, Italy, Brazil, China — varies by SKU, not consistently one factory). Known for decorative patterns at low price points. Red body ceramic typical. Non-rectified pressed edges — wide grout lines required. PEI 2 (light traffic only). Water absorption 3-7% (semi-vitreous — not suitable for exterior or heavy wet areas). Breaking strength <1300N. Fails freeze-thaw. Screen-printed surface patterns (legacy technology). Installer reports: shade variation and dimensional inconsistency between boxes. 1-year warranty or per-manufacturer warranty routed through Home Depot.
calibration_products.corporate_parent: Merola Tile (importer/distributor — stocked through Home Depot)
calibration_products.outlook_rationale: Home Depot distribution ensures availability. Quality is builder-grade decorative positioning.
